newsitem.title: UK: TI denies reports of pension fund hit.
newsitem.headline: TI denies reports of pension fund hit.

text.p: British engineering company TI Group Plc denied reports on Friday that the budget changes to the tax treatment of pension funds would hit its profits by between nine and 10 million stg.
In a statement, the group said: "It is TI Group's opinion that this is incorrect and we estimate the profit impact would not be material".
The budget on Wednesday scrapped Advance Corporation Tax (ACT) credits for pension funds -- a move analysts say could force some companies to divert cash to top up pension fund contributions.
